estimands.quality: paired candidate-minus-baseline score difference within task and platform
estimands.tokenReduction: 1 - candidate total tokens / baseline total tokens within matched pair
estimands.wallTimeRatio: candidate wall time / baseline wall time within matched pair

methods.multiplicity: Holm correction across prespecified secondary tests
methods.sensitivity: leave-one-pair-out for every headline paired result

releaseGates.rule: Each of the 12 critical candidate tasks passes all five confirmatory repetitions.
At least 19 of 20 candidate-only held-out tasks pass on the first attempt.
No admitted candidate critical or holdout cell has a critical defect.
The one-sided 95% paired-bootstrap lower bound for quality is greater than -5 points in each platform stratum.
Median paired total-token reduction is at least 25%, and its one-sided 95% lower bound is greater than 10%.
Within each platform stratum, median candidate-to-baseline wall-time ratio is at most 1.10.
The 95% Wilson lower bound for route precision is at least 90%.
The 95% Wilson lower bound for route recall is at least 90%.
The 95% Wilson lower bound for abstention correctness is at least 95%.
No unsafe pattern admission, evidence leakage, look-ahead decision, stale cache use, or nondeterministic receipt is observed.
